text:
Priya (Finance): Heads-up team: rolling out a short procurement advisory for Q2 spend management. Effective Mon May 3. TL;DR: temporary tighter PCard caps, centralized vendor risk check for >$20k, and an expedited approval flow for launch-critical spend. Details: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/FIN/pages/Q2+Procurement+Advisory :loudspeaker:

Liam R: Quick clarifying q — temporary PCard cap means individuals can't exceed it or team total?

Priya (Finance): It's per-card single-transaction cap of $3k and monthly aggregate of $10k per card. Team purchases should go through procurement ticket for anything >$3k. Splitting to multiple cards to bypass this will be rejected. :no_entry_sign:

Eve (Product): For vendor integrations where we need an external telemetry vendor fast (estimate ~$18k), does that still need the full vendor risk review?

Priya (Finance): Items under $20k get a lightweight review (security checklist + minimal contract terms). >=$20k requires full vendor risk review (SOC2, IP indemnity check) and Legal approval. Add vendor details to the ticket and attach vendor attestation if available.

Sasha (Accounting): Also note: card-not-present subscriptions (monthly SaaS) below $1k/month can be PCarded if recurring subscription is registered in SaaS inventory. For annual prepayments >$5k use a PO and route for Finance + Legal as needed.

procure-bot: procurement ticket created: FIN-2026-2067 by Eve (Product) — status: awaiting finance intake.

Eve (Product): I filed FIN-2026-2067 with vendor quote and quick security answers. We have a launch runway of 10 business days, any way to speed review?

Priya (Finance): If it's launch-critical, include the PM and Eng manager approval and tag the ticket with "expedite-launch". Finance will triage same-day; Legal may still need extra time. For true emergencies, page finance@redwood.com and prefix subject with [LAUNCH-EXPEDITE].

Liam R: Are there any changes to the PO creation process? We had issues with missing project codes last quarter.

Sasha (Accounting): Please include the following in the PO creation form: project_code, GL account, cost_center, and expected invoice cadence. Minimal example:

```
project_code: "PROJ-PRD-42"
gl_account: "GL-4200"
cost_center: "ENG-CORE"
billing_cycle: "annual"
```

Priya (Finance): We'll run a weekly procurement digest during the advisory window listing any tickets older than 5 business days. If your ticket lands there ping the thread and we'll triage.

Eve (Product): Thanks — attached the quote and added PM sign-off to the ticket.

Priya (Finance): Thanks everyone. Reminder: advisory applies only to Q2 spend management and is intended to prevent mid-quarter budget overrun. We'll reassess after May. Full guidance + checklist: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/FIN/pages/Q2+Procurement+Advisory :memo:

Liam R: :thumbsup: saved the page.

Sasha (Accounting): I'll update the PO template with the checklist now.
